notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 2 power.
easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
Your library isn't empty.
description:
Activate Sash and Waistcoat by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters, Thunder of Unity and Davvol trigger.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Davvol trigger, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life
Repeat.
